top_macro_signals: SEBI and RBI tightening risk architectures while accelerating instant digital rails (Account Aggregator, vKYC).
Retail FinTechs pivoting rapidly from pure discounted broking to high-yield MTF and advisory cross-sell lines.
Automated self-serve servicing (>80%) and lower cost-to-serve emerging as the defining drivers of P&L resilience.

briefing_cards.headline: Angel One, 5paisa, BSE and other capital market stocks slide up to 3% as SEBI weighs MTF curbs; Is the MTF party over?
briefing_cards.summary: Shares of SMC Global Securities, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, 5paisa Capital, Angel One and BSE fell up to 3% amid reports that SEBI is considering limits on leveraged stock purchases. Proposed restrictions could apply when margin-funded holdings reach a set share of a company’s free float.
briefing_cards.pl_impact: Direct impact on collateral utilization and net interest margins (NIM). Brokerages scaling automated risk platforms can expand MTF books with controlled capital adequacy.
briefing_cards.action_trigger: Post on LinkedIn: 'The Structural MTF Advantage: Why Technology & Real-Time Risk Surpass Aggressive Fee Discounting in Broking Economics.'
